author: penabilt
body: Hi my user name in game is penabilt. I would like to be unbanned because I was banned for anti knock back but I was against a wall and I couldn't move if I tried, and I am loyal to this server, or was loyal until I got banned. I love this server and would love to be a part of this again. I believe this ban was false and I believe that this wait I had was long enough and that I should be unbanned. Thank you for your reasoning.

replies.body:
Hello,

Considering that there is no evidence of you hacking, and the fact that you're explanation seems valid, I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, you'll be unbanned. However, if we ever catch you hacking again, you will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
